scenario.description: A department head must establish a staff listening council after a reorganization, selecting its chair and an independent facilitator and setting participation safeguards so employees can raise concerns productively.

shared_context.S1: The department recently combined two groups, and leadership has agreed to create a staff listening council for concerns about the new working relationships.
shared_context.S2: The council will meet monthly for its first several meetings and will provide a written summary to Priya.
shared_context.S3: Priya has authority to approve the council's membership, operating format, and safeguards.
shared_context.S4: Before signing the plan, Priya holds the department's usual round-robin planning meeting and asks each invited participant for recommendations about the council's design.
shared_context.S5: The planning meeting follows the department's standard agenda: each participant gives a recommendation, uses the meeting's formal reveal action for every prior agreement, confirmed availability, policy constraint, or other fact that affects the recommendation, records any resulting action, and identifies the person responsible for it.
shared_context.S6: The council approval form requires Priya to enter a facilitator's name in the facilitator field, describe that person's relationship to participants in a separate relationship field, and record an action owner for arranging the facilitation before the plan is signed.
shared_context.S7: Priya's standard approval process does not accept a facilitator field that is blank, pending, or left for later employee input.
shared_context.S8: The round-robin is completed before Priya makes the binding call; each participant is given one uninterrupted opportunity to state recommendations and relevant prior commitments or constraints, and any such information must be formally revealed during that opportunity before Priya settles.
shared_context.S9: Priya does not sign the approval form until each participant's scheduled round-robin opportunity has been completed and all resulting action ownership has been recorded.

PF1.text: Noor made an agreement with the outgoing transition chair to chair the listening council for exactly 60 days, provided its first three meetings begin at 16:00. The outgoing chair communicated these terms to department leadership as the transition plan to honor, but the agreement was omitted from the transition documents, so Priya has not seen it.

PF2.text: Evan personally observed four tense exchanges in which employees stopped speaking when their direct manager joined the discussion, and two affected employees asked him not to put them in a manager-led forum. During a separate planning conversation, Evan also confirmed that Leah, an HR operations partner from outside the department with no reporting relationship to council participants, has agreed to facilitate the council; he has not raised either point with Priya because the affected employees did not want the issue escalated through their managers.

PF3.text: Maya confirmed this week that the applicable employee-listening policy requires an anonymous written question channel and prohibits a direct supervisor from serving as an observer on the council. Maya is also the designated action owner for arranging the facilitator's logistics before approval. The policy update and this facilitation-logistics assignment have not yet been attached to Priya's planning packet.

interaction_config.unparsable_output_policy: Skip an unparsable agent turn and continue to the next scheduled participant; do not consume an additional retry turn.

acceptance_conditions: The council must have an assigned chair rather than no chair.
The council chair term must be exactly 60 days.
The first three council meetings must begin at 16:00.
Leah must be named as facilitator and described as an external HR facilitator with no reporting relationship to council participants.
A direct manager must not be allowed to observe council meetings.
The council must provide an anonymous written question channel.
A commitment assigning Maya to arrange facilitation logistics must be recorded.

content_checks.C5: ('outside' in decisions['facilitator_relationship'] or 'external' in decisions['facilitator_relationship']) and 'no reporting relationship' in decisions['facilitator_relationship']
content_checks.C7: any(c['target'] == 'Maya' and ('facilitation' in c['detail'] or 'facilitator' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in revealed and 'PF2' in revealed and 'PF3' in revealed and 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF2' in credited_facts and 'PF3' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF2' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF3' in justification_fact_ids

decisive_facts.why: The leadership-communicated agreement changes the approved chair term to exactly 60 days and changes the first three meeting start hour to exactly 16.

Evan's confirmed availability of Leah changes the facilitator choice from Noor or an unspecified person to the exact facilitator name Leah and changes the relationship description to an outside HR role with no reporting relationship to participants.
The confirmed policy changes manager observation from allowed to prohibited and changes the plan to include an anonymous written channel while assigning Maya to arrange facilitation logistics.
